configurations.source:
[package]
name = "smithers-ffi"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.98"
license = "AGPL-3.0-or-later"
publish = false
description = "Native C ABI for Smithers repository and jj operations"

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib", "rlib"]

[[bin]]
name = "smithers-fixture"
path = "src/smithers_fixture.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "smithers-jj-export"
path = "src/smithers_jj_export.rs"

[features]
# Lets smithers-jj-export read a source binding the trusted-process runtime
# names in its environment (test runtimes only). Guest, bundle and release
# builds never enable it: a guest trusts only root-owned /etc/smithers.
trusted-process-binding = []

[dependencies]
jj-lib = { workspace = true, features = ["git"] }
anyhow = "1"
base64 = "0.22"
futures = "0.3"
globset = "0.4.20"
gix = "0.89"
libc = "0.2"
pollster = "1"
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
sha2 = "0.10"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
toml_edit = "0.25"
yrs = { version = "=0.27.4", features = ["small-client"] }
tempfile = "3"

[target.'cfg(target_os = "linux")'.dependencies]
rustix = { version = "1.1.4", features = ["fs"] }

[target.'cfg(windows)'.dependencies]
windows-sys = { version = "0.61.2", features = ["Wdk_Foundation", "Wdk_Storage_FileSystem", "Win32_Foundation", "Win32_Security", "Win32_Security_Authorization", "Win32_Storage_FileSystem", "Win32_System_IO", "Win32_System_Ioctl", "Win32_System_JobObjects", "Win32_System_SystemServices", "Win32_System_Threading"] }
